title: Rooms Keys Present — payload
description: An agent asks the party holding its principal's room credentials to produce a presentation for one room operation. The credentials never cross to the agent; only the presentation does, and it is bound to the operation it was asked for.

action.description: The action the presentation must confer. Named here so the produced presentation can be scoped to it: a presentation minted for `read` should not be reusable for `write`, and a holder that mints one covering everything has handed the agent its own standing.

audience.description: The party the presentation is for, so it cannot be replayed elsewhere. A host's identifier, normally.

nonce.description: Freshness value from the verifier, echoed into the presentation. Without one a captured presentation is replayable for as long as its credentials live.

presentation.description: The presentation to send to the host: a membership credential, an authority chain, and — where the room withholds the subject — a same-subject binding.

expiresAt.description: When the presentation stops being accepted, so a caller can avoid presenting a stale one.
